messages:
talia_marketing: Hey team — new launch post draft is up: https://docs.example.com/prod-launch-v1. Need fast passes on benchmark wording, regional CTAs, JP/DE short copies, and inbound routing. Can we lock by tomorrow noon? :spiral_calendar:

ben_growth: I got CTAs + A/B plan. Propose Webinar-first vs Quickstart-first by region. I'll add GA events: launch.variant & launch.cta.

ryan_pm: Bench source = internal bench-v3 on identical A100 config. Current line says '30% faster p99' — prefer "~30% lower p99 latency (internal tests)" and include a short methodology block.

mina_legal: Please avoid absolutes. Suggested legal-safe sentence: "Based on internal benchmark v3 comparing Redwood runtime to OpenModelX on identical hardware. Methodology: 3,000 requests; mixed sequence lengths; p99 measured across 5 runs." Replace "industry-leading" with "industry-competitive."

harry_ops: For routing/playbook include mapping: ```region_map = {"NA":"sales-na","EU":"sales-eu","APAC":"partners-apac"}``` Webinar ops: EU slots Tue/Thu 10am CET, capacity 40 -> auto-waitlist at 40. Also append utm: `?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=prod_launch&utm_variant=A|B`.

talia_marketing: Thanks — pasted Mina's legal sentence and the methodology block into the draft. Reworded superlatives. Link: https://docs.example.com/prod-launch-v2.

ben_growth: CTA short copies (<=45 chars):
- Variant W (webinar): "Join our launch webinar" -> tags: `lead:webinar`, `route:region-based`
- Variant Q (quickstart): "Open the quickstart & deploy" -> tags: `lead:docs`, `route:docs-flow`
JP short (webinar): "" (will paste final into doc)
DE short (webinar): "Live-Demo: Jetzt anmelden"

mina_legal: LGTM after one tweak: change "controlled tests" to "controlled internal tests" and place methodology on its own line.

ryan_pm: Made that tweak and updated the benchmark to "~30% lower p99 latency (internal tests)." Pushed v3.

publish-bot: Reminder: draft freeze in 14 hours for scheduling.

talia_marketing: If there are no objections by noon tomorrow I'll mark copy locked and hand to ops. Thanks all :rocket:
